HD2 HUD+ 0.1.2
by DDRK1NG

Shows what your weapon is doing, next to the crosshair - so you read
it without looking away from where you are aiming.

  - Rounds left and reserve, by the crosshair
  - A reload arc that fills while you reload
  - A charge arc that fills as a charge weapon winds up
  - The fire mode your weapon is in
  - Backpack ammo for weapons fed from a pack

Tick Core, then pick what you want to see.
Each group is off unless you tick it:

  Arc                      A ring by the crosshair for rounds, or heat on weapons that build it. A second arc inside it fills while you reload.
  Numbers
    Rounds and reserve     What you can fire now and the reserve behind it. Backpack ammo shares the spot.
    Rounds only            Just the number you can fire right now - no reserve. Backpack ammo shares the spot.
  Weapon icon
    By the crosshair       The fire mode your weapon is in, next to the crosshair.
    By the game HUD        The fire mode, larger, beside the game's own HUD - leaves the crosshair clear.
  Keep it visible when idle Leaves the crosshair HUD faint while nothing is changing. Turn this off to have it fade away completely instead.

  - Scales with your resolution and HUD Scale setting.
  - Correct in four-player games.
  - Writes no log and no settings of its own.

Drop this folder (or a zip of it) into your mod manager, enable it,
and deploy. Removing it is disabling the mod and deploying again - the
patch is additive and replaces no original file.

After a Helldivers 2 update, do not deploy this build until it has
been rebuilt: it carries the game's own boot chunk with the mod
appended, so an old build pins an outdated copy.
